method: 使用内置 imagegen 分别生成 10 幅私人委托插画和 1 幅领航标记插画。原始生成文件保留；项目副本命名为 m01-unique.png 至 m10-unique.png、leader-unique.png。

prompts.m01:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: unique illustration for ONE private commission card in the Chinese steampunk skyship tabletop game The Dawn Raid (劫走黎明).
World: entirely aerial. Mountain cities, docking towers and steam rotor skyships stand high above a deep cloud deck. No ocean, water, shoreline, seagoing boats or naval imagery.
Style: the same premium hand-painted adventure-book look as the existing sky edition: oil and gouache brushwork, finely etched riveted iron and weathered brass, petroleum teal shadows, restrained amber light, ivory mist. Believable late-industrial machinery, no magic.
Composition: landscape 16:9, one unmistakable focal story, readable in a small 55 × 19 mm card window. Moderate inkjet-friendly contrast and open midtones. Dignified hope with an elegy for old industry; dramatic but not sentimental.
Constraints: artwork only; no frame, card layout, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.
Commission: 让旧城亮灯.
Scene: A dark cliffside workers' city at predawn, layered brick homes and iron walkways carved into a mountain. A mechanic connects a compact salvaged furnace generator on an outdoor platform; a clear wave of warm lamps begins lighting one street while most of the city remains blue-grey. One small steam skyship hovers at the delivery crane above the cloud abyss.
